description: The delivery history behind the Alerts page table: every alert, scheduled report, report attached to an alert, and test sent through an alert channel in the last 90 days, with the channel and recipients, the budget and the threshold that fired (`trigger_key`), the window a report covered, status and a truncated error. An alert and the report attached to it share a `delivery_key`. Attached reports skipped for a cooldown, the hourly cap or no data appear too. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/alert-history.
name: list_alert_history
